model.name: Ming Image 0.2 Design 6B
model.description: Generate text-rich posters, interface mockups, and product imagery from a prompt, or edit one reference image. Supports structured layouts and optional RGBA output.

prompt: A botanical exhibition poster on warm ivory paper. A large dark-green fern frond curves across the lower two thirds. Print the exact title "FERN STUDY" at the top in bold forest-green lettering. Place the small date "JUNE 12" below the title. Keep the rest of the poster free of text.
